_about: Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), session 199. The inputs of the 20 test questions of Ask ERCOT about four pages (warehouse/chat/eval_ercot_pages.json), as the page files held them on the day the questions were written: only what the questions read, in the page files' own shape (files), and for each flat load its months in place of its hours (flat_months: month, then the sum of the hourly prices held in USD per MWh, the hours held, the hours due). Written by warehouse/chat/eval/ercot_pages_expected.py --write; not edited by hand. The pages read the day's files, not this one. The resource layers (site/data/resources) are not copied here: no scheduled run rebuilds them
